tweets.text: So I received my BCNR package decision today and quite honestly I am surprised at what was told. Promotion in rank with effective date of one year after I was discharged, time served with no break in service, and obviously all the back pay things we all know about. It is now on me to submit paperwork to get that official $ amount offer. I did not realize time served would be a thing, that alone has me contemplating some things lol. I know there's been a lot of issues with this but the Navy has stepped up the comms a lot lately, and they approved everything I asked for at BCNR. Now back pay will be mostly a rank higher than I expected too. Much to evaluate, just figured Id update all in here.
